visual_description: A high-quality parchment-style document resting on a rustic wooden table. The header reads 'CONSENT TO PROSPECT' in a bold, serif font. Key sections visible include 'Term of Access', 'Liability Waiver', and a 'Division of Discovery' clause. A signature line at the bottom features a wax seal or an official project stamp from the 'DinoGames' museum. A vintage fountain pen and a set of brass keys to a ranch gate sit next to the paper.

constraints.logic: Establishes the legal right to keep fossils found on private property, which—unlike federal land—are the property of the landowner until transferred.
constraints.background: A warm, interior ranch house office with soft window light.
